# Single boiler espresso machine, 58mm

Price: $400

Three years old and descaled every few months. It pulls a good shot and steams milk well.

One thing to know: the steam wand knob is stiff. It works, it just needs a firm turn.

## What's included

- 58mm portafilter
- Tamper
- Milk jug

Pickup from Leichhardt. You can see it running before you buy.

BARISTA quality espresso machine for the serious home coffee lover who wants the very best!

$480. Works perfectly.
